description:
Activate Folio of Fancies by paying {2} and taping it, causing each player to draw a card.
Xyris triggers, creating a 1/1 Snake token for each card that opponent drew.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Folio of Fancies.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a 1/1 Snake token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
